specific_attribution_correction: Production-line and technical-upgrade commissioning cannot support IMPLEMENTATION or EXECUTION of the frozen channel, terminal-partner and logistics plan.

independent_review_findings.why_below_standard: The test registered CN:600802 into a caller-owned in-memory SQLite database and invoked private J2/J3 compilers. The company was never admitted through the canonical Frozen J1 production identity and public projection boundary.
independent_review_findings.economic_impact: A result can appear traceable while its enterprise boundary and frozen cutoff state are not the production object used by later judgments, creating a material risk of training on a non-replayable company state.
independent_review_findings.prohibited_assumption: A caller-owned test registry is equivalent to canonical production registration.
independent_review_findings.executable_remediation: Register the complete J1 bundle through the canonical registry control layer and call only public J2/J3 APIs using Frozen J1 identity.
independent_review_findings.acceptance_criteria: The builder has no caller connection or private compiler dependency, canonical lookup succeeds by Frozen J1 identity, and public J2/J3 outputs bind that identity.

independent_review_findings.why_below_standard: The nine measurement cells omitted outcome period, responsibility boundary, field identity, unit, formula or event threshold, ordered labels, composite-signal rules and sibling-local mismatch propagation.
independent_review_findings.economic_impact: The same filing can be assigned different operating, execution, cash or loss labels by researcher discretion, which can falsely upgrade management quality or action causality.
missing_facts: period and responsibility boundary per field
independent_review_findings.prohibited_assumption: Narrative or aggregate improvement uniquely settles implementation, execution, customer response or action effect.
independent_review_findings.executable_remediation: Split composites into atomic cells and freeze a static Outcome Measurement Contract containing every missing identity and decision rule before outcome access.
independent_review_findings.acceptance_criteria: A custodian can mechanically produce one label per atomic cell, and a synthetic mismatch changes only declared dependants while siblings remain OBSERVED or UNKNOWN.

independent_review_findings.why_below_standard: The pre-outcome package supplied completed_company_ids instead of deriving them from immutable roster rows and formal completion or settlement receipts.
independent_review_findings.economic_impact: A judgment owner can skip inconvenient companies or cutoffs by editing package input, introducing outcome-linked sampling bias into enterprise learning.
missing_facts: formal disposition for the outcome-contaminated transition
independent_review_findings.prohibited_assumption: Caller-declared completed companies are equivalent to mechanically verified prior feedback receipts.
independent_review_findings.executable_remediation: Derive completed companies and consumed transitions from formal receipts, then select the first remaining immutable roster row without a lifecycle or ease filter.
independent_review_findings.acceptance_criteria: Changing caller-supplied company IDs cannot change selection; changing a validated receipt set or immutable roster can.

retained_post_outcome_data.retention_reason: The official raw values may document data availability and support post-outcome teaching, but cannot settle the frozen mechanism contract.
